INDICATOR_NAME: Internally displaced people (IDP) by country or territory of asylum / origin
SOURCE_NOTE: Internally displaced people (IDPs) are persons or groups of persons who have been forced or obliged to flee or to leave their homes or places of habitual residence, in particular as a result of, or in order to avoid the effects of armed conflict, situations of generalized violence, and violations of human rights, and who have not crossed an internationally recognized State border.
